items.title: Supre – A prompt engineer for Suno AI's Style of Music field
items.raw_excerpt: I've been using Suno for months and kept hitting the same wall: the Style of Music field is the most powerful parameter, but there's almost no guidance on how to use it well. So I built Supre. You pick genre, mood, BPM, instruments, vocal style and which Suno version you're using — it generates a calibrated Style prompt specifically for that version. Built with Claude Haiku on the backend, Vercel serverless, Upstash Redis for rate limiting. Try it: https://supre.online/en/tool (2 free generations/day, no signup)

items.title: UI-stack – Claude skill that enforces design system on AI-generated UI
items.raw_excerpt:
The problem with AI-generated frontend code is that without constraints, every generation picks different spacing, colors, and patterns. The 50th component looks nothing like the first.
ui-stack is a Claude Code skill — a set of structured reference files that Claude reads when building UI. It's built for Next.js + Tailwind + Shadcn but the principles are framework-agnostic.
What's interesting about the "skill" approach vs. a system prompt: the reference is modular and file-based, so you can update one file (say, colors.md) and the change propagates everywhere. There's also a browser-based config dashboard so you can customize your brand palette and font before the skill activates.
Would love feedback — especially from anyone who's tried to enforce design consistency across a large Claude

The problem with AI-generated frontend code is that without constraints, every generation picks different spacing, colors, and patterns. The 50th component looks nothing like the first.
ui-stack is a Claude Code skill — a set of structured reference files that Claude reads when building UI. It's built for Next.js + Tailwind + Shadcn but the principles are framework-agnostic.
What's interesting about the "skill" approach vs. a system prompt: the reference is modular and file-based, so you can update one file (say, colors.md) and the change propagates everywhere. There's also a browser-based config dashboard so you can customize your brand palette and font before the skill activates.
Would love feedback — especially from anyone who's tried to enforce design consistency across a large Claude

excerpt_i18n.en: The e-commerce version of "Wukong" is here! Recently, Alibaba officially launched the world's first enterprise-level AI-native work platform—"Wukong." In the e-commerce sector, the core operational capabilities of Taobao and Tmall will be gradually integrated in the form of Skills (skill modules). Taking "optimizing product materials" as an example, with Wukong, merchants only need to arrange the corresponding AI workflow. The AI Agent will automatically complete preliminary tasks like "data analysis → providing suggestions." After the merchant confirms the updates with one click, the AI Agent will automatically execute "material creation → updating."

Los comerciantes podrán combinar estos Skills como si fueran bloques de construcción y crear sus propios flujos de trabajo de IA en Wukong, formando un equipo de Agentes de IA que estará disponible en cualquier momento y lugar, cubriendo todas las etapas como apertura de tienda, selección de productos, marketing, operaciones y envíos. Lo más impresionante es que, además de la gestión en comercio electrónico, los comerciantes también podrán acceder a través de Wukong a diversos Skills profesionales como finanzas, asuntos legales, diseño, desarrollo tecnológico, entre otros, para formar un conjunto completo.

For instance, in autonomous driving systems, visual models are required to recognize road signs and pedestrians; in intelligent security systems, facial recognition models are used for identity verification; in medical image analysis, deep learning models can assist doctors in identifying disease features. However, recent studies have consistently shown that these high-performance models still have significant security vulnerabilities. Among these, the adversarial example problem is considered one of the most critical security challenges facing deep learning systems. For example, by adding imperceptibly small perturbations to a traffic sign image, an autonomous driving system might misclassify a "speed limit sign" as a "stop sign"; in facial recognition systems, introducing subtle noise to an image can cause the model to misidentify one person as another. These minor input changes can lead to completely erroneous predictions by the model, a phenomenon that not only reveals the fragility of deep neural networks at decision boundaries but also poses serious challenges to the security of real-world systems. 2026 marks the beginning of the 15th Five-Year Plan and a critical milestone for China as it advances toward the basic realization of socialist modernization by 2035. At this historical juncture, technological innovation serves not only as an engine for economic development but also as a cornerstone for national rejuvenation. On March 14, International Mathematics Day, Runzeyuan Education held an "Infinite Innovation" conference at the Hangzhou International Expo Center in Zhejiang.
